background_story: Karson 'The Bull' rose to power in the underworld of 1920s New York City. A ruthless and cunning mafia enforcer, he earned the respect and fear of his peers through his brutal efficiency. Karson's loyalty to the Don was unwavering, and he would stop at nothing to protect the family's interests. His meteoric rise through the ranks was marked by a series of high-profile 'hits' and strategic power plays. But beneath the tough exterior, Karson had a soft spot for his family and would do anything to keep them safe. His reputation as a formidable mafioso was cemented when he took down a rival gang, securing the Don's position as the city's most powerful crime lord. Karson's name became synonymous with power, loyalty, and the unwritten code of omertà.
